stages.name: Tin Admiral, Hasty and Captain
stages.rule: Every stage is a boss from Worlds 1-5 with two modifiers
stages.answers: Pierce (Hammerhead, Spearhead, Volcanist), Strong-vs-Armoured, Breakers; Scout block, Strong-vs-Fast Striker (Lancer, Snowpup), Slow; Anti-air (Sparrow, Skyreaver), Strong-vs-Flying Rangers (Skyhook, Harpooner); Fast Strikers (Blizzardfang), Reach (Longshot), Rally; Area (Mortar, Catapult), Reach
stages.hint: Fliers pass over melee. Bring Anti-air or a Strong-vs-Flying Ranger.
